name: Tanked 3: First Blood 2

features.name: xLoot
features.description: Characters collect gems of their colour.

features.name: Bombs
features.description: Fire in one or three directions.

review:
More board game than slot. With xLoot, there are no paylines – characters move around a 4-5-6-5-6-5-4 grid picking up gems of their own colour, while wilds can be collected by anyone. Coins worth 1x to 5,000x are up for grabs too.

Bombs fire in one or three directions, and xGlitch throws in surprises. Strange but fun to watch. High volatility, 25,584x max, 95.99% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
